en.title: New Transit Accessibility Plans and iOS Features Highlight Disability Inclusion
en.summary: The MTA unveiled detailed accessibility specifications for the upcoming Interborough Express line, including level boarding, wheelchair spaces, and audible‑visual announcements. Additionally, Apple highlighted five iOS accessibility tools that benefit all users, while UNESCO Japan promoted community‑based employment support for people with disabilities. The combined initiatives underscore a growing focus on inclusive design across transportation, technology, and social programs.

zh-TW.title: 城際特快線 無障礙 設計 公布 iOS 功能 推廣 包容
zh-TW.summary: MTA 公布城際特快線的無障礙車輛設計細節，強調平臺無階上落、輪椅空間以及聲音與視覺廣播。Apple 同時推介五項 iOS 無障礙功能，讓所有使用者受惠；聯合國教科文組織日本則推動社區就業支援，提升殘障者的社會參與。這些舉措顯示交通、科技與社會領域對包容設計的日益重視。
